snippet.title: 1897 Korea(18Korea) - 1.0v Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hop aboard a train across the Korean peninsula and its railroad history.

1897 Korea(18Korea) is based on the long-time beloved board game series, '18xx'. We support 2~5 local and online multiplayer with a save&load system. 

Be the best entrepreneur by running alternative history railroad companies and trading stocks of them. Also, make your strategy under the clouds of the Korean War which will destroy every city and station.

Get it on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1758370/1897_Korea/
